extraction.Name: Winnie Bull Tail, formerly Winnie Larvie
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 26, 1920, by Bartine
extraction.Buyer: Winnie Bull Tail, nee Larvie and Moses Bull Tail conveyed the land by deed to H. Z. Brown for $2500
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739662 issued; Northeast quarter section 7, township 36, north of range [not fully legible]; receipt for patent was signed April 3, 1920, by the allottee; conveyance dated July 21, 1920
